body.purpose: Readable explanatory copy and normal control text.

label.purpose: Field labels, buttons, metadata, and navigation copy.

mono.purpose: Paths, serialized values, placeholders, and generated expressions.

shadows.name: payload-hairline

shadows.name: focus-ring-light
shadows.purpose: Visible focus-within ring around the payload boundary in light appearance.

shadows.name: focus-ring-dark
shadows.purpose: Visible focus-within ring around the payload boundary in dark appearance.

motion.name: disclosure-transition
motion.purpose: Chevron orientation feedback on disclosure rows.

motion.name: drawer-transition
motion.purpose: Mobile navigation drawer entrance and exit.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Compact graphite action for creating or committing configuration changes.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 7px; min-height: 36px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid var(--accent); border-radius: 6px; background: var(--accent); color: var(--accent-inverse); font: 650 13px/1.4 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Text', 'Helvetica Neue', sans-serif; white-space: nowrap; transition: opacity 120ms ease, transform 120ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary svg { width: 14px; height: 14px; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { opacity: .88; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Quiet Button
components.description: Neutral bordered action for secondary and navigation-adjacent choices.
components.css: .ds-btn-quiet { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 7px; min-height: 36px; padding: 0 10px; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 6px; background: var(--surface); color: var(--text-soft); font: 650 13px/1.4 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Text', 'Helvetica Neue', sans-serif; white-space: nowrap; transition: background 120ms ease, border-color 120ms ease, color 120ms ease, transform 120ms ease; } .ds-btn-quiet:hover { border-color: var(--border-strong); background: var(--surface-muted); color: var(--text); } .ds-btn-quiet:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-quiet:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Danger Button
components.description: Semantic red action used for deletion and repair-risk choices.
components.css: .ds-btn-danger { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 36px; padding: 0 10px; border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--danger) 38%, var(--border)); border-radius: 6px; background: transparent; color: var(--danger); font: 650 13px/1.4 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Text', 'Helvetica Neue', sans-serif; white-space: nowrap; transition: background 120ms ease, transform 120ms ease; } .ds-btn-danger:hover { background: var(--danger-soft); } .ds-btn-danger:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-danger:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-danger.ds-is-filled { border-color: var(--danger); background: var(--danger); color: #fff; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Native field with a strong hairline, readable padding, and explicit focus treatment.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 5px; color: var(--text-soft); font: 650 13px/1.4 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Text', 'Helvetica Neue', sans-serif; } .ds-field input { width: 100%; height: 36px; padding: 0 10px; border: 1px solid var(--border-strong); border-radius: 6px; background: var(--surface); color: var(--text); font: 400 14px/1.45 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Text', 'Helvetica Neue', sans-serif; transition: border-color 120ms ease; } .ds-field input:hover { border-color: var(--text-muted); } .ds-field input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Navigation Item
components.description: Neutral rail navigation row with a tonal selected state.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: grid; gap: 3px; padding: 8px; background: var(--surface); } .ds-nav-item { display: flex; align-items: center; width: 100%; gap: 10px; min-height: 36px; padding: 0 10px; border: 0; border-radius: 7px; background: transparent; color: var(--text-soft); text-align: left; font: 650 13px/1.4 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Text', 'Helvetica Neue', sans-serif; transition: background 120ms ease, color 120ms ease; } .ds-nav-icon { width: 16px; height: 16px; color: var(--text-muted); } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: var(--surface-muted); color: var(--text); } .ds-nav-item.ds-is-active { background: var(--surface-selected); color: var(--text); } .ds-nav-item.ds-is-active .ds-nav-icon { color: var(--text); } .ds-nav-count { margin-left: auto; color: var(--text-muted); font-weight: 400; } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Action List Item
components.description: Scannable action row that keeps the name, payload detail, and selection state legible.
components.css: .ds-action-item { display: flex; align-items: center; min-width: 0; width: 100%; gap: 9px; padding: 9px 7px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 7px; background: transparent; color: var(--text); text-align: left; font: inherit; transition: background 120ms ease, border-color 120ms ease; } .ds-action-item:hover { background: var(--surface-muted); } .ds-action-item.ds-is-selected { border-color: var(--border); background: var(--surface-selected); } .ds-action-item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-action-icon { display: grid; width: 27px; height: 27px; flex: 0 0 auto; place-items: center; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 7px; background: var(--surface); color: var(--text-soft); font: 650 13px/1 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Text', sans-serif; } .ds-action-copy { display: grid; min-width: 0; gap: 2px; } .ds-action-copy strong, .ds-action-copy small { overflow: hidden; line-height: 1.45; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-action-copy strong { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 650; } .ds-action-copy small { color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 13px; }

components.name: Source Pill
components.description: Small neutral badge that identifies the origin or inheritance state of an action.
components.html: Inherits Defaults
components.css: .ds-source-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; min-height: 19px; padding: 2px 6px; border-radius: 4px; background: var(--surface-muted); color: var(--text-soft); font: 650 13px/1.4 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Text', sans-serif; } .ds-source-pill svg { width: 13px; height: 13px; } .ds-source-pill.ds-source-invalid { background: var(--danger-soft); color: var(--danger); }

components.name: Source Pill — Repair
components.description: Semantic repair badge for an action whose saved configuration needs attention.
components.html: Needs repair
components.css: .ds-source-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; min-height: 19px; padding: 2px 6px; border-radius: 4px; background: var(--danger-soft); color: var(--danger); font: 650 13px/1.4 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Text', sans-serif; } .ds-source-pill svg { width: 13px; height: 13px; } .ds-source-pill:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Connection Card
components.description: Quiet status card that explains the live, fixture, fallback, or disconnected connection.
components.html:
Fixture connected

Connected to the in-memory fixture adapter.
components.css: .ds-connection-card { padding: 11px 11px 10px; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--surface-muted); color: var(--text); font: 400 13px/1.45 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Text', sans-serif; } .ds-connection-line { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; font-weight: 650; } .ds-status-dot { display: inline-block; width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--text-muted); } .ds-status-connected { background: var(--success); } .ds-status-warning { background: var(--warning); } .ds-status-error { background: var(--danger); } .ds-connection-card p { margin: 5px 0 0; color: var(--text-muted); line-height: 1.4; }

components.name: Disclosure Row
components.description: Progressive-disclosure row that keeps advanced configuration available without crowding the first path.
components.html:
ConditionsMatch a phrase, app, mode, or URL.2 configured⌄
Structured controls and deliberate raw mode.
components.css: .ds-disclosure { border-top: 1px solid var(--border); color: var(--text); font: 400 13px/1.45 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Text', sans-serif; } .ds-disclosure summary { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px; min-height: 58px; padding: 8px 1px; list-style: none; cursor: pointer; } .ds-disclosure summary::-webkit-details-marker { display: none; } .ds-disclosure summary > span:first-child { display: grid; gap: 3px; min-width: 0; } .ds-disclosure strong { font-weight: 650; } .ds-disclosure small, .ds-disclosure-meta { color: var(--text-muted); } .ds-disclosure-meta { margin-left: auto; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-chevron { color: var(--text-muted); transition: transform 130ms ease; } .ds-disclosure[open] .ds-chevron { transform: rotate(180deg); } .ds-disclosure summary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-disclosure-body { padding: 0 0 19px; color: var(--text-soft); }

components.name: Payload Editor
components.description: Signature text-editing boundary with built-in modes, helper affordance, and explicit draft status.
components.html:
Custom text
12 characters✓ Saved
components.css: .ds-payload-editor { overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid var(--border-strong); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--surface); color: var(--text); box-shadow: 0 1px 1px rgba(0,0,0,.025); } .ds-payload-editor:focus-within { border-color: var(--focus); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--focus-soft); } .ds-payload-toolbar { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; min-height: 42px; padding: 5px 8px 5px 13px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); } .ds-payload-toolbar > span { color: var(--text-muted); font: 700 13px/1.4 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Text', sans-serif; letter-spacing: .03em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-toolbar-button { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; min-height: 28px; padding: 0 8px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 6px; background: transparent; color: var(--text-soft); font: 650 13px/1.4 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Text', sans-serif; transition: background 120ms ease, border-color 120ms ease; } .ds-toolbar-button svg { width: 14px; height: 14px; } .ds-toolbar-button:hover { border-color: var(--border); background: var(--surface-muted); } .ds-toolbar-button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-payload-editor textarea { display: block; width: 100%; min-height: 173px; padding: 11px 12px; border: 0; border-radius: 0; outline: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--text); font: 400 14px/1.55 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Text', sans-serif; resize: vertical; } .ds-payload-footer { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; min-height: 30px; padding: 0 11px; border-top: 1px solid var(--border); color: var(--text-muted); font: 400 13px/1.4 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Text', sans-serif; } .ds-saved { color: var(--success); font-weight: 650; }

narrative.overview:
This is an operate-mode interface for a local configuration editor. It should feel like a calm control room: dependable, legible, and ready for a precise adjustment without demanding attention from the work around it. Graphite, white, and gray surfaces establish hierarchy through tone, borders, and spacing rather than decoration.

The system is compact but not cramped. Familiar controls carry the interaction, while progressive disclosure keeps advanced conditions, chaining, placeholders, and raw syntax available without making the first useful path feel technical. Light and dark appearances use the same neutral roles; green, amber, and red are reserved for connection, save, warning, and error meaning.
keyCharacteristics: Quiet graphite-and-paper surfaces with no colored cast.
A clear navigation rail, top context bar, and focused editing workspace.
State made explicit with text, icons, and restrained semantic color.
Dense enough for configuration work, with a single-surface mobile path.

rules.name: The Quiet Surface Rule
rules.body: Keep surfaces, navigation, and controls inside the graphite/white/gray family. Semantic hues are for status and risk, never for decoration.

rules.name: The State Must Speak Rule
rules.body: Never make a status depend on color alone: pair semantic color with a label, icon, or explicit copy.

rules.name: The Utility Type Rule
rules.body: Use system sans for prose and controls; reserve monospace for paths, serialized values, and expressions. There is no decorative display face.

rules.name: The Flat Resting Rule
rules.body: Keep ordinary navigation, list items, fields, and settings flat. Reserve shadows for transient layers or the payload boundary's barely perceptible separation.

dos: Do use neutral graphite, white, and gray roles for all resting surfaces and structural chrome.
Do reserve green, amber, and red for connection, saved/saving, warning, error, and destructive states, and pair each with text or an icon.
Do show whether a value is Saved, Saving, Unsaved, Not saved, inherited, a built-in template, fixture-backed, or live-connected.
Do keep advanced syntax behind a deliberate disclosure or raw-mode opt-in while keeping the raw value recoverable.
Do preserve the desktop navigation → list → editor hierarchy and the mobile list/editor single-surface behavior.
Do keep familiar native controls, visible focus, readable wrapping, and reduced-motion behavior.
donts: Don't introduce blue, purple, gradients, or colored surface washes into the neutral editor chrome.
Don't use semantic color as decoration or as the only signal for state.
Don't imply that a fixture-only, failed, or disconnected write was saved to the real configuration.
Don't flatten every advanced setting into an always-open form or hide the consequences of raw configuration.
Don't add strong shadows to ordinary rows, cards, or controls; depth belongs to transient layers.
Don't replace the canonical configuration semantics with a simplified visual-only model.
